feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 16 May 2026 9:58pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 16 May 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the northwest of Scotland as a frontal zone continues to clear the British Isles as various troughs approach from the west of Ireland.


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, backing southwest 3 or 4 tomorrow night.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the south later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers these becoming more frequent later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 2 to 4, backing south or southeast 3 to 5 Monday afternoon and occasionally 6 in the west later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate at first then becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Showers soon clearing as it becomes fair for a time. Rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.
